title: Alvin Kamara injury: Saints star expected to miss at least a month with MCL sprain, per report

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints lose Alvin Kamara for at least a month in injury blow
sources.description: The star suffered an MCL sprain during a joint practice with the Cowboys on Tuesday and is expected to miss at least one month, ESPN reported Wednesday.

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Alvin Kamara injury: Saints star expected to miss at least a month with MCL sprain, per report
sources.description: Kamara, who suffered the injury in a joint practice with the Cowboys, is set to miss Week 1 for just the second time in his career
